boundary: This ledger records bounded workflow evidence. Same-owner validation is not independent reproduction and does not establish scientific, legal, cultural, identity, production, security, accessibility, deployment, or Stage 20 claims.
identity_boundary: Relational working language only; not consciousness, personhood, continuity, employment, or authority evidence.

methods.candidate_workaround: Run each Git command as a separate statement, capture LASTEXITCODE, and assemble the receipt only after every probe returns.
methods.failure_signature: A compound PowerShell proof embeds command and exit-code capture inside one parenthesized expression and fails at parse time.
methods.recurrence_guard: Do not place command invocation and LASTEXITCODE capture inside the same parenthesized assignment.
methods.rollback: Give the failed wrapper zero credit and rerun only the read-only probes as independent statements.
methods.scope_boundary: Read-only PowerShell orchestration only; no repository or remote state is changed.
methods.title: Split PowerShell Git proof from exit-code assembly
trigger_preconditions: Several Git ancestry probes must be combined into one sanitized receipt on Windows PowerShell.

methods.candidate_workaround: Inspect the exact serialized keys, bind the declared field, and preserve the source receipt unchanged.
methods.failure_signature: A version probe binds an assumed property and returns null because the committed receipt uses a different exact field name.
methods.recurrence_guard: Never infer receipt property names from prose when the committed schema is available.
methods.rollback: Retain the null result and give it no version evidence credit.
methods.scope_boundary: Schema-binding recovery only; it performs no application update.
methods.title: Inspect serialized receipt schema before property binding
trigger_preconditions: A current phase reads a structured receipt produced by an earlier phase or builder.

methods.candidate_workaround: Read the runner-produced state after witness ingestion and request only the remaining validated-to-preferred transition.
methods.failure_signature: A builder requests candidate-to-validated after the runner has already promoted the method on a passing witness.
methods.recurrence_guard: Treat runner state transitions as authoritative; never replay an already-applied transition.
methods.rollback: Retain the failed builder run, delete no witness, and rebuild the uncommitted ledger from its declared inputs.
methods.scope_boundary: Method Flow orchestration only; no scientific or authority gate is affected.
methods.title: Respect Method Flow automatic witness promotion
trigger_preconditions: A method is recorded as candidate and the family runner ingests a bounded passing witness.

methods.candidate_workaround: Build the current intended surface from cached, unstaged, and untracked path sets before comparing coverage.
methods.failure_signature: A post-stage coverage check reads only unstaged and untracked paths and reports the entire cached surface as absent.
methods.recurrence_guard: Never infer the staged surface from git diff without --cached after index mutation.
methods.rollback: Retain the failed suite, leave staged blobs unchanged, and rerun only after the coverage-domain fix is staged.
methods.scope_boundary: Git path-set accounting only; it does not change artifact contents or outcome claims.
methods.title: Union cached unstaged and untracked paths for staged coverage
trigger_preconditions: An exact staged manifest is validated after git add while the worktree itself has no remaining unstaged paths.

methods.candidate_workaround: Classify only the exact scanner implementation and exact privacy receipt as scanner-definition surfaces.
methods.failure_signature: A regenerated privacy scan reads its previous receipt and treats scanner-class names in that exact receipt as payload hits.
methods.recurrence_guard: Never exempt a directory, wildcard, unrelated receipt, or arbitrary generated output from privacy adjudication.
methods.rollback: Retain the failed scan and keep the x1 commit blocked until zero non-definition candidates remain.
methods.scope_boundary: Exact scanner metadata only; zero confirmed hits is not complete privacy assurance.
methods.title: Exact self-referential privacy receipt disposition
trigger_preconditions: A privacy receipt is a declared self-exclusion and already exists from a prior uncommitted builder run.

methods.candidate_workaround: Probe file existence and byte length first, then run syntax and status checks independently.
methods.failure_signature: A short compound inspection times out while reading line counts before status or syntax evidence is attributable.
methods.recurrence_guard: Do not place content-wide line counting, status, and syntax checks in one short wrapper.
methods.rollback: Give the timed-out wrapper zero credit and retain the unmodified worktree.
methods.title: Split large-file inspection into bounded metadata and syntax probes
trigger_preconditions: New or generated implementation files must be inspected on a latency-variable Windows worktree.

methods.candidate_workaround: Assign the foreach result to an array and pipe that array in a separate statement.
methods.failure_signature: Windows PowerShell 5.1 reports an empty pipe element when a foreach statement is piped directly.
methods.recurrence_guard: Never pipe directly from a PowerShell 5.1 foreach statement.
methods.rollback: Retain the parser failure with zero credit; no repository state requires rollback.
methods.title: Assign PowerShell foreach output before piping
trigger_preconditions: A Windows PowerShell 5.1 probe must format or filter rows produced by foreach.

methods.candidate_workaround: Use a longer bounded native exact-pattern search on only the known file.
methods.failure_signature: An exact search of one known implementation file exceeds its short wrapper bound despite a small apparent byte size.
methods.recurrence_guard: Treat measured Windows worktree latency, not apparent file size, as the timeout input.
methods.rollback: Give the timed-out search zero credit and retain the unchanged worktree.
methods.title: Escalate a timed exact-file search to a bounded native probe
trigger_preconditions: A known exact file and exact pattern set must be inspected after a short search timeout.

methods.candidate_workaround: Load the exact frozen runner names and union them with the fixed builder, runtime, test, and owner-packet paths.
methods.failure_signature: An exact staged preflight rejects every generated runner because a guessed prefix omits their declared family-current filenames.
methods.recurrence_guard: Never substitute a guessed naming prefix for an available frozen filename ledger.
methods.rollback: Give the rejected preflight zero evidence credit and stage nothing until the exact-name check passes.
methods.scope_boundary: Owner-scoped path accounting only; no broad script-directory exemption is allowed.
methods.title: Derive staged runner scope from the frozen runner-name ledger
trigger_preconditions: A phase generates runner files from an X1-frozen runner-name ledger.

witnesses.boundary: Failed orchestration witness only; no source, branch, worktree, or remote state changed.
witnesses.expected: Every ancestry exit code is captured and serialized.
witnesses.observed: The PowerShell parser stopped at the embedded statement separator before any Git state changed.
witnesses.procedure: Run the combined parenthesized PowerShell source-proof wrapper.

witnesses.expected: Exact anchors, parent count, commit count, merge count, cleanliness, and four-way equality are attributable.
witnesses.observed: All anchors were ancestral; final directly followed evidence; history had three commits and zero merges; source and Ilyra lanes were clean and remote-equal.
witnesses.procedure: Run source, x1, and evidence ancestry probes separately, capture each exit code, then assemble one receipt.

witnesses.boundary: Failed schema assumption only; no application was updated.
witnesses.expected: The inherited CLI version is returned.
witnesses.observed: The property was absent and the probe returned null.
witnesses.procedure: Read the assumed codex_cli property from the inherited version receipt.

witnesses.boundary: Version verification only; no desktop or CLI update occurred in this phase.
witnesses.expected: The source CLI and desktop observations are returned without mutation.
witnesses.observed: The source and live CLI both reported 0.144.5 and the inherited desktop observation remained 26.715.4045.0 with desktop_updated false.
witnesses.procedure: Inspect the committed receipt keys and read codex_cli_after and codex_desktop exactly.

witnesses.boundary: Failed lifecycle orchestration only; partial uncommitted artifacts received no freeze credit.
witnesses.expected: The method reaches validated once and remains auditable.
witnesses.observed: The redundant set-state request returned nonzero after the runner had already promoted the method.
witnesses.procedure: Ingest a passing witness and then request candidate-to-validated again.

witnesses.boundary: Bounded workflow recovery only; same-owner evidence is not independent reproduction.
witnesses.expected: The valid transition sequence completes without erasing any witness.
witnesses.observed: The runner preserved fail and pass witnesses, auto-promoted to validated, and accepted the single remaining transition to preferred.
witnesses.procedure: Ingest the passing witness, inspect the resulting validated state, and request only preferred.

witnesses.boundary: Failed coverage-domain witness only; no commit was created.
witnesses.expected: All intended cached x1 paths are represented.
witnesses.observed: Blob parity passed, but the test falsely reported all cached paths missing from the empty unstaged set.
witnesses.procedure: After staging, compare manifest coverage against unstaged and untracked paths only.

witnesses.boundary: Bounded same-owner Git coverage evidence only.
witnesses.expected: The complete 49-path staged surface is covered exactly once in the declared hash domain.
witnesses.observed: The union matched the intended surface and every staged index blob matched its manifest hash.
witnesses.procedure: Union cached, unstaged, and untracked paths and compare them with manifest entries plus self-exclusions.

witnesses.boundary: Failed privacy-disposition witness; no commit or route action occurred.
witnesses.expected: Scanner metadata remains distinguishable from payload content.
witnesses.observed: The receipt's own class labels were reported as two confirmed payload hits and blocked the builder.
witnesses.procedure: Rescan an existing self-referential privacy receipt without declaring its exact scanner-metadata role.

witnesses.boundary: Structural privacy evidence only; it is not complete privacy assurance.
witnesses.expected: Only exact scanner metadata candidates remain and confirmed payload hits equal zero.
witnesses.observed: The bounded rescan retained scanner metadata candidates and reported zero confirmed payload hits across the complete x1 surface.
witnesses.procedure: Classify the exact scanner implementation and exact self-referential privacy receipt as scanner definitions, leaving every other path fail-closed.

witnesses.boundary: Failed orchestration witness only; no repository mutation occurred.
witnesses.expected: All inspection evidence is returned within the bound.
witnesses.observed: The wrapper timed out before returning attributable evidence and changed no state.
witnesses.procedure: Count lines, inspect status, and parse new implementation files in one short wrapper.

witnesses.expected: File presence and syntax are independently attributable.
witnesses.observed: Both implementation files were present, the evidence builder was complete, and both compiled successfully.
witnesses.procedure: Inspect existence and byte length separately, then compile the two implementation files in a second bounded probe.

witnesses.boundary: Parser failure only; no repository mutation occurred.
witnesses.observed: The parser stopped at the direct pipeline and no command body executed.
witnesses.procedure: Pipe directly from a foreach statement to Format-Table in Windows PowerShell 5.1.

witnesses.expected: Three exact file rows are returned.
witnesses.observed: The probe reported both implementation files present and the pending test file absent without mutation.
witnesses.procedure: Assign the foreach result to a rows array, then pipe rows to Format-Table separately.

witnesses.expected: Count-mirror and authority terms are returned.
witnesses.observed: The search exceeded its bound and produced no attributable result.
witnesses.procedure: Search the exact evidence builder for a fixed pattern set under a ten-second wrapper.

witnesses.expected: Every relevant match is returned without broad tree traversal.
witnesses.observed: The native exact-file probe returned the retained-negative mirrors and correctly encoded Māori authority terms.
witnesses.procedure: Run a longer bounded Select-String probe over only the exact evidence builder and exact pattern set.

witnesses.boundary: Failed allowlist witness only; no index or commit mutation occurred.
witnesses.expected: All exact generated runners are admitted.
witnesses.observed: The preflight rejected ten declared family-current runner files and staged nothing.
witnesses.procedure: Validate the generated surface with a guessed ghc_family_v648_v4_ script prefix.

witnesses.expected: Every intended path is admitted and no unrelated path is admitted.
witnesses.observed: The exact-name preflight covered the generated runner set while retaining a zero-path out-of-scope result.
